issues.description: The problem statement and the template expect Farm to provide a method named singFarmSong(), but the solution implementation provides a method named playFarmSong() instead. This name/signature mismatch means the solution does not implement the method students are asked to create and will confuse students (and any tests) that expect singFarmSong().
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the solution method playFarmSong() to singFarmSong(), or add a public singFarmSong() wrapper that calls the existing playFarmSong() implementation. Ensure the method name and signature exactly match the one specified in the problem and template.

issues.description: The problem statement and the template expect a Farm method named singFarmSong(), but the solution implements this functionality under a differently named public method playFarmSong(). This mismatch (singFarmSong vs playFarmSong) refers to the same conceptual operation (playing/singing the farm song) and will confuse students trying to map the required API to the reference implementation.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the solution's public method playFarmSong() to singFarmSong() to match the problem statement and template. Alternatively, add a public singFarmSong() method in the solution that delegates to playFarmSong() so the API expected by students and tests matches the reference implementation.
